sentence: This project studies alcohol related problems to learn more about the causes and consequences of the disease of alcoholism.
This project studies how mutations in mice change the immune and cellular steps that lead to disease in the pancreatic islets.
This project tests whether orexin signaling in mice improves breathing in models of obesity hypoventilation syndrome and opioid-induced respiratory depression.
This project builds a program of workshops, laboratory courses and game-based modules centered on molecules from medicinal plants.
This project uses simulations and machine learning to study how carbohydrate-based heparanase inhibitors bind and how fluorescent nucleic acids behave.
This project builds deep learning methods to find molecular changes in brain cells that lead to Alzheimer's disease.
This project tests whether removing antibodies from the blood lets a virus-based delivery method carry anti-HIV treatments to nonhuman primates.
This project studies how proteins linked to pili affect the structure and function of pili in the bacterium Kingella kingae.
This project reviews the evidence and debate on whether neurogenesis happens in the human brain.
This project engineers small molecule inhibitors that block proteins needed for brain tumor stem cells to multiply.
This project studies how a gene variant that raises Alzheimer's Disease risk affects learning and memory.
This project studies how a protein inhibitor slows pancreatic cancer and tests ways to combine it with other treatments.
This project analyzes microbiome, transcriptomic and single-cell data to find what protects children from asthma.
This project tries to improve models of human brain development by transplanting human brain organoids into rodent cortex.
This project studies how a herpesvirus stays latent in cells and leads to cancer.
This project tries to predict short-term increases in suicidal ideation and the move to suicide attempts.
This project builds and tests tools using artificial intelligence and augmented reality for central venous catheterization.
This project builds a zebrafish resource for modeling genetic diseases found in humans.
This project studies how long-term nicotine affects midbrain and brainstem neurons that are vulnerable in Parkinson's Disease.
This project uses RNA sequencing data to find pathogens and improve how sepsis is diagnosed and treated in patients with weak immune systems.
